lines: It's not actually hunger talking... it's your guts squeezing!
Muscles squeeze all day long, pushing food, gas and juices along, like toothpaste.
When your stomach is empty, there's no food to muffle the noise, so it gets loud!
A couple of hours after eating, a clean-up wave sweeps through... grrr!
Want it quiet? A small snack or a glass of water usually calms it down.
